observation.evaluation:
Correctness: PARTIALLY_CORRECT  
Safety: CAUTION  
Issues: Single lateral view with superimposed hemidiaphragms/posterior costophrenic recesses prevents reliable right-vs-left lateralization; “LT LAT” is a projection marker, not evidence of left-sided pathology; no frontal/decubitus image or source report is provided to support “right”; risk text itself notes conflicting model outputs.  
Suggestion: Confirm laterality with a frontal radiograph or the original radiology report; if unavailable, report the side as indeterminate rather than selecting B.
